maria (PM): Quick sync: customers want a single API request to run multiple tool steps. We need defaults for ordering, retries, and timeouts. Short ideas?

kevin (eng): Keep it simple: phases array. Each phase = type (parallel|sequential), tools list, timebox_ms, retry_budget. Server enforces invocation_limit and per-request budget.

sanjay (infra): Phase model is ok. Add per-customer concurrency_quota and global hedging toggle. Timebox helps avoid unbounded memory. Distinguish retryable errors (429/5xx) vs non-retryable.

elaine (prodops): Hosted defaults should be conservative: invocation_limit=6, timebox_ms=3000, retry_budget=1. Dedicated can expose tunables. Need clear billing: per-invocation tokens + orchestration overhead.

olivia (design): UX: default sequential for chat tool-calls to preserve streaming. For agent/batch allow phased parallel. Show `partial:true` and `missing_tools` in responses. Keep API param minimal: {"phases": [...], "idempotency_token": ""}.

maria (PM): Roadmap suggestion: alpha on Dedicated (phases-only) -> run perf at small/med/large fanout -> host if tail-latency & memory ok. Launch criteria: idempotency, observability (per-tool traces), docs + migration guide. Owners: kevin impl, sanjay limits, elaine gating, olivia docs. Meeting next week to review prototype.
